# Direct Windows full-suite diagnostic

This supplementary diagnostic preserves frozen39b runtime/test/build inputs. It follows the independently retained normal SwiftPM run37699465385 at diagnostic28a. A direct run never changes or relabels that run's outcome.

The dedicated `codex/windows-test-direct-diagnostic-*` push trigger and concurrency group do not match the original diagnostic trigger or portable-release branches. Publication remains with the sole delivery owner. The default-branch workflow-dispatch prerequisite has not been assumed.

The workflow keeps native ownership/drainage controls, protected policy/signing/observer tests, a complete native test build, full SwiftPM discovery, complete direct tests, release build and actual seven-operation provider acceptance. Release/provider steps run only after full direct completion, with ordinary failure gating. No production source, existing Tests, fixtures, Vendor or packaged scripts is changed.

The helper rejects any tracked or untracked packaged-input difference from39b and any `_SWIFTPM_SKIP_TESTS_LIST` presence; it retains only the absence boolean. It requires the existing x86_64 PE at `.build/x86_64-unknown-windows-msvc/debug/rightclick-mcpPackageTests.xctest`, records its SHA256/source and checks the hash after each phase. It reads installed SDK `Info.plist` versions to select the exact XCTest and Testing DLL directories in the same prepend order as SwiftPM6.2; no complete environment or process arguments are retained.

Before executing tests, the actual compiled runner's `--dump-tests-json` inventory must contain666 distinct names exactly equal to the preceding complete SwiftPM discovery. The full XCTest invocation supplies no arguments or filter. A zero exit alone cannot pass: every expected case must have one start, one finish, no failure, and the complete666-case summary. Existing supported-platform skips are counted explicitly. The second full Swift Testing invocation supplies only its library selector; frozen source has no Swift Testing declarations, and actual output must prove its zero-test completion. Both full libraries must complete before release/provider gates can run.

Each invocation uses the already reviewed supervisor. The direct XCTest is now its retained root process handle, so its actual exit code is available even if fixtures retain pipe handles. The supervisor then cleans only that owned process tree and bounds pipe drainage. Inner full-XCTest deadline24minutes plus Swift Testing2minutes remains below the combined30-minute step. This bypasses SwiftPM's intermediate output collector for diagnosis; native CRT buffering may still affect when rows appear.

Seven local controls cover duplicate/changed/incomplete inventories, completion with missing or failing cases, counted platform skips, exact installed DLL selection and PE architecture. These parser/configuration controls pass on Mac; the actual native runner, DLL setup, inventory equality and full test completion remain RED until the dedicated Windows run provides them.

Primary source references: [SwiftPM test invocation](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/Commands/SwiftTestCommand.swift), [Windows test environment](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/Commands/Utilities/TestingSupport.swift), [installed DLL path derivation](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/PackageModel/UserToolchain.swift), [SDK plist keys](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/PackageModel/WindowsToolchainInfo.swift), [XCTest full-run and inventory semantics](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-corelibs-xctest/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/XCTest/Public/XCTestMain.swift).
